endpoint_correction_note.correction: The earlier response used an independently optimized per-bin upper estimate and adaptive realized covers. The released analysis reconstructs every Track C pair on the clean reference's fixed realized pullback memberships and evaluates the exact joint Definition-9 objective.

model: D_M_exact = beta0 + beta_n*(n-10) + beta_e*(eps-0.15) + beta_12*(n-10)*(eps-0.15) + categorical alpha effects (0.05 reference) + replicate-stream effect + error
estimator: ordinary least squares after within-stream demeaning
secondary_interval: CR1 cluster-by-stream sandwich with t_9 critical value

terminal_states.T4: full fit rank deficient or bootstrap failure rate exceeds 5 percent

scope_limits: executed n_intervals and eps grid only
bilinear summary is not a global surface law
alpha is a categorical nuisance adjustment
no Reeb, manifold-topology, or method-superiority claim
